design_context: Caregiver management app for elderly care. Requires a compassionate, soothing, organic, and ultra-readable interface with clear visual hierarchy, real-time delay counters, audit logging, multi-patient support, and PWA Web Push capabilities.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FBF8F3] text-[#2C3531] pb-24 relative shadow-2xl sm:border-x sm:border-[#E4DDD3]
spacing_and_layout.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#FBF8F3]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#E4DDD3] px-4 py-2 flex justify-around items-center z-50 rounded-t-2xl shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
spacing_and_layout.card_padding: p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-[#E4DDD3] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

delay_counter.description: Real-time delay indicator shown when a medication dose or appointment is past due and not yet completed.
delay_counter.styles: bg-[#FEE2E2] text-[#B84A39] border border-[#FCA5A5] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold font-mono inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-pulse
delay_counter.format: ex: '15 min de atraso' / '1h 20min de atraso'

action_buttons.completed: bg-[#3E6B48] hover:bg-[#33583B] text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 shadow-sm
action_buttons.not_completed: bg-[#FAF0EC] hover:bg-[#F5E2DA] text-[#C86D51] border border-[#F0C4B6] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95
action_buttons.status_badge_done: bg-[#EAF3EC] text-[#3E6B48] border border-[#A7D7B0] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1
action_buttons.status_badge_missed: bg-[#FAF0EC] text-[#C86D51] border border-[#F0C4B6] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1

push_notification_banner.active_state: bg-[#E9EFEB] border border-[#B3CBC0] text-[#5B7065] p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between
push_notification_banner.inactive_state: bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#FDE68A] text-[#92400E] p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between

interactive_features.today_schedule_dashboard: Aggregates daily medication doses (recurring daily) and appointments for all caregiver's patients for today, ordered by scheduled time.
interactive_features.real_time_delay: Uses a 10-second ticker logic to recalculate exact minutes/hours overdue for uncompleted items past scheduled time.
interactive_features.patient_tabs: Patient detail view featuring tabs: 'Medicações', 'Compromissos', and 'Histórico' (Audit log of actions with date, status, notes, caregiver name).
interactive_features.multi_tenant_auth: Caregiver authentication with email/password; isolated patient data per logged-in caregiver.
interactive_features.web_push_vapid: Support for enabling Web Push notifications using VAPID keys with immediate exact-time alerts for medications and advance warnings (1 day and 2 hours prior) for appointments.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tab items, cards, and delay counters MUST carry semantic `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire user interface is in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
Keep mobile-first responsive design as the primary target, using smooth transitions, rounded corners, and clear typography.
Implement multi-tenant data scoping: each caregiver sees only their own created patients, medications, and appointments.
Ensure real-time delay counter updates dynamically when an action remains unfulfilled after scheduled time.
Set up service worker and manifest for PWA installation capabilities and push notification handlers.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML inputs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent background on dropdowns or floating navs; use layered blur or solid surfaces.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, tab, and form input.
Use sonner for user feedback toasts (e.g., 'Medicação marcada como concluída').
Maintain generous spacing, soft earthy rounded borders, and crisp typography hierarchy.
